verdict.rationale: Ironclad's documented event mechanism is webhooks, which POST to a URL you specify when chosen events occur. Webhooks can be created and managed in the UI or via API, with signing, authentication and auto-deactivation. To make those events drive actions, you need an external integration, for example one that automatically blocks or pushes forward approvals, so the rule logic lives in your own code rather than in a native rule builder. Missing for 10: a native in-product event-to-action rules engine, documented conditional trigger logic within Workflow Designer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
